div.l: This pardoner bar with hym / a styff bordoıı̄un
Was neuer trompe of halff so gret a sowoıı̄un A pardoner
This pardoner hadde heer / as yelwe as wex
But smothe it heng / as doth a stryk of flex
By vnas huge / his lockis that he hadde
And thervith / he his shuldris over spradde
But thynne it lay / by culpownys on and on
But hood for Iolyte / wered he noon
For it was trussed vp / in his walet ·
Hym thouhte he rood / all of the newe get
Dischevel save his cappe / he rood al bare
Such glaryng eyen hadde he / as an hare
A vernycle had he / sewed vpon his cappe
His walet bi forn̄ hym / in his lappe
Breed ful of pardoū / come fro Rome al hoot
A voys hadde / as smal as had a goot
No bred hadde he / ne nevyr shuld have
As smothe it was / as it were late shave
I trowe he were / a geldyng or a mare
But of his craft / fro Berwyk on to ware
Ne was ther such / an other pardonere
For in his male he hadde / a pelwe bere
Which he seyde / was our lady veyl
He seide that he hadde / a gobet of the seil
That seynt petir hadde / whan that he wente
Vp on the se / til IħuIhesu crist hym hente
He hadde a croys of latonıı̄un / ful of stonys
And in a glas he hadde / pigges bonys
But with these relykes / whan that he fond
A pore ꝑpersoıı̄un dwellyng / vp on lond
Vp on day / he get moor moor moneye
Than that ꝑpersoıı̄un / gat in monethis tweye ·
